I have updated the styles to ensure that all cards in the grid have the same height and that their action links are consistently aligned at the bottom.

Here's a summary of the changes made to `src/styles.css`:

1.  **Updated the grid alignment**: Changed `.grid` from `align-items: start` to `align-items: stretch`. This ensures that all cards in a row automatically expand to match the height of the tallest card in that row.
2.  **Enabled flexbox on cards**: Added `display: flex` and `flex-direction: column` to the `.card` class.
3.  **Aligned action links**: Added `margin-top: auto` to the `.card a` style. This pushes the "Start tracking..." links to the bottom of the card, ensuring they align perfectly even when the description text lengths vary.

```332:343:src/styles.css
.card {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f1a45cc, #0c1538cc);
  border: 1px solid #ffffff14;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--spacing-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transition: all var(--transition-normal);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
```

```237:243:src/styles.css
.grid {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--spacing-lg);
  align-items: stretch;
}
```

```417:427:src/styles.css
.card a {
  margin-top: auto;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--spacing-xs);
}
```
